items.title: Microsoft Teams “couldn’t connect” Error Following Recent Sidebar Update – Fix Released
items.description: Microsoft is in the process of deploying a fix for a service degradation issue affecting Microsoft Teams users globally, which presents a “couldn’t connect to this app” error upon launching the desktop and web applications. items.title: Asian Orgs Shift Cybersecurity Requirements to Suppliers
items.description: The uptick in breaches in Asia has prompted a Japanese chipmaker and the Singaporean government to require vendors to pass cybersecurity checks to do business.
